description: For natural bases two at most b less than c and every natural m, changing the base to c preserves the canonical hereditary expression and its ordinal value; positive inputs remain positive.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.base_change_spec (b c m : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hbc : b < c) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.hereditary c (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.baseChange b c m) =
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.hereditary b m ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.ordinalMeasure c (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.baseChange b c m) =
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.ordinalMeasure b m ∧
      (0 < m → 0 < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.baseChange b c m)
